sentiment.rationale: Full-year comparable EPS guidance was raised from 7%-8% to 8%-9% versus $3 in 2025, and the organic revenue growth guidance of 4%-5% was reaffirmed. The guidance raise is partially attributed to a lower effective tax rate (19.9% vs. prior estimate), which is a non-operational item, but management also expressed confidence in delivering balanced top-line growth and margin expansion. The Q&A revealed some caution on commodity pressures and geopolitical uncertainty, but the overall forward signal is moderately positive.

summary.revenue: Net revenues grew 12% to $12.5 billion; organic revenues (non-GAAP) grew 10%.
summary.eps: Comparable EPS (non-GAAP) grew 18% to $0.86; reported EPS grew 18% to $0.91.
summary.guidance: Organic revenue growth expected in the 4%-5% range; comparable currency-neutral EPS growth (ex-acquisitions/divestitures) of 6%-7%; comparable EPS growth now guided to 8%-9% versus $3 in 2025, up from prior 7%-8% estimate due to a reduced effective tax rate of 19.9%.
summary.margin: Comparable operating margin expanded approximately 70 basis points; comparable gross margin declined approximately 30 basis points.
key_risks: Comparable gross margin declined 30 bps due to commodity pressures in tea and coffee and inventory timing; these cost headwinds expected to persist.
Uncertainty stemming from geopolitical tensions may cause the outlook to change.
Divestitures (including Coca-Cola Beverages Africa sale) expected to create a 4-point headwind to comparable net revenues and a 1-point headwind to comparable EPS.
March volumes in Eurasia and Middle East declined after onset of regional conflict.
Mexico facing headwinds from implementation of a sugar tax.
key_opportunities: Organic revenue growth of 10% in Q1, with 3% unit case growth across all segments.
Value share gains for 20 consecutive quarters.
System added more than 600,000 outlets and placed over 340,000 units of cold drink equipment.
Innovation (Coca-Cola Zero-Zero, Sprite, Fuze Tea) driving double-digit volume growth for Fuze Tea.
Pending sale of Coca-Cola Beverages Africa expected to improve overall company margin profile in second half of 2026.
Currency tailwinds: 1%-2% to comparable net revenues, 3% to comparable EPS for full year.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Henrique Braun stated, 'We are off to a good start this year. We delivered strong first quarter results despite a complex external environment. I'm confident we are well positioned to deliver on our updated 2026 guidance.'
